name: OpenVector
long_description: OpenVector transforms any existing camera into an automated 24/7 workforce without requiring new hardware. Users simply describe a task in plain English, and OpenVector automatically builds a custom AI vision model to monitor the feed. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action. It integrates with legacy systems to make calls, send emails, update a POS/CRM, or trigger webhooks in real time. OpenVector enables any camera to do real work.
one_liner: AI that turns any camera into an active operator with real-time vision
